name: Minimum Variance - Bond Universe + 8% Vol Target
description: Applies minimum variance optimisation to the fixed-income universe (US Treasuries, USD-hedged global aggregate, global high yield, EUR govt bonds, India INR govt bonds), finding the lowest-volatility allocation within bonds alone, then scales to 8% annualised volatility. Tests how diversification mechanisms behave when correlations are structurally higher within a single asset class rather than across equities, bonds, and commodities.
